schema.description: A medicine course ending, which closes its med.regimen series. Written into records files by hand, from My Health Record screenshots or the person's own word. Named health.medication-stopped (v1) until its name gained a third segment.

agreed_with.description: Who the stop was agreed with, as the writer recorded it.

course.description: Which course of this drug, counting from 1; a restart after a stop is a new course. Assigned by whoever wrote the record, not by the source. With drug it names the regimen series.

date.description: The day the course stopped, YYYY-MM-DD, as the writer recorded it. This is the fact time.

drug.description: The generic drug name in lower case, as the record's writer normalised it from the source. With course it names the regimen series.

id.description: Identity, chosen by the writer: the source prefix, then med, the drug, the course and "stopped".

reason.description: Why the course stopped, in the writer's words.

source_note.description: What the reader saw in the source and how they reached this record (which screenshot, which dispensing). Reader's text, not the source's.
